4f2f89d4c4e34628.job_title: Allergan Aesthetics Medical Science Liaison (Saudi National)
4f2f89d4c4e34628.description: About AbbVie and Allergan Aesthetics AbbVie, through its Allergan Aesthetics division, develops, manufactures, and markets a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. This portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, and skin care. The company's objective is to provide customers with innovation, education, and exceptional service, maintaining a commitment to excellence. Role Overview: Medical Science Liaison This full-time Medical Science Liaison position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and focuses on current and upcoming Medical Aesthetics portfolios and their associated indications. The role involves developing and maintaining professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders to provide comprehensive medical and scientific support for Allergan initiatives within assigned therapeutic areas. This is a non-promotional role, primarily focused on providing Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) with fair and balanced scientific information. Key Responsibilities Drive Key Opinion Leader (KOL) engagement. Lead scientific exchange with HCPs and provide feedback to cross-functional teams on future medical activities. Contribute to brand strategy and the development of tactical planning in collaboration with the marketing department's brand team. Contribute to the overall competency of Medical Affairs, including technical aspects. Support medical-marketing messaging and required approval procedures. Execute the Medical Affairs plan for Saudi Arabia and the MEA region. Provide scientific education and training initiatives across the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. Conduct field visits with key physicians and stakeholders. Organize advisory board meetings. Facilitate clinical trials. Serve as a medical resource for both external and internal stakeholders. Facilitate information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding current and future therapies developed or commercialized by Allergan. Collaborate with other Allergan personnel to ensure the information, education, and research needs of healthcare professionals are met, and to identify and address the scientific and technical training needs of commercial organizations. Required Experience and Skills 2-5 years of relevant experience. Expertise in the therapy area. Demonstrated ability in business planning. Experience in internal and external training and education. Proficiency in thought leadership identification, development, and engagement. Involvement in clinical studies feasibility. Understanding of Pharmacovigilance and compliance principles. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with various internal teams and external healthcare professionals, contributing to the broader Medical Affairs objectives within the MEA region.

4fad32295e82cdc9.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking a Vendor Technical Enablement Mentor to provide on-site technical mentoring to Authorized Service Provider (ASP) field teams. This full-time role is based in Riyadh or Jeddah and requires 5-10 years of experience. The primary objective is to enable ASP teams to execute end-to-end telecommunications site activities safely, correctly, and consistently with Ericsson's operational standards. Role Context and Objectives The Vendor Technical Enablement Mentor will work directly with field teams, offering hands-on coaching across various technical domains. This includes installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover processes. The role aims to enhance ASP technical capability and self-sufficiency in areas such as RAN, transmission, power, civil/site quality, and technical site surveys. Key Responsibilities Coach ASP field teams through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, restoration, and handover procedures. Demonstrate technical standards for radio, microwave transmission, power, cabling, antennas, and site works. Review site readiness, surveys, TSSRs, drawings, BoQs, configurations, work plans, and site connections to identify technical risks before execution. Support installation and commissioning quality, including cabling, grounding, RF checks, transmission configuration/alignment, power checks, alarms, and test records. Troubleshoot RAN, transmission, power, and site-related faults, assisting with root-cause identification and corrective actions. Reinforce Ericsson technical standards, processes, tools, quality checkpoints, EHS, and customer requirements. Identify capability gaps and recurring quality issues, providing targeted coaching and practical knowledge transfer. Escalate safety risks, non-conformances, unresolved technical issues, and delivery risks. Coordinate with ASP supervisors, project/operations teams, and technical specialists to resolve dependencies and support timely handover. Maintain required site and technical documentation and promote ASP self-sufficiency. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in telecommunications field operations or technical enablement. Demonstrated technical expertise across RAN, transmission, power, and civil/site quality. Experience with installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of telecommunications equipment. Proficiency in reviewing technical documentation such as TSSRs, drawings, and BoQs. Working at Ericsson Ericsson offers an environment where individuals can apply their skills to develop solutions for complex challenges. The company fosters a diverse and inclusive organization, believing that collaboration among individuals with different experiences drives innovation and future growth. Ericsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applications from all backgrounds.

Conduct regular site inspections of HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, fuel, water, drainage, and other mechanical systems. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to resolve mechanical and construction-related issues. 4f15abd8d15e650d.description: About the Role RemoteOne is recruiting on behalf of a rapidly expanding Saudi coffee brand for a Supply Chain & Sales Operations Manager. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a hands-on professional to manage purchasing, stock, and distributor orders as the brand expands across the GCC and North Africa region. The ideal candidate will have experience in both supply chain and sales operations within a growing FMCG or food and beverage business. This role involves actively managing processes rather than merely overseeing established operations. The manager will be responsible for ensuring efficient supply chain functions and smooth sales operations to support regional growth. Key Responsibilities: Supply Chain & Procurement Manage the complete purchasing cycle, including supplier selection, price and quality comparisons, payment terms negotiation, purchase order generation, and delivery follow-up. Develop and maintain relationships with local and international suppliers and partners. Oversee import and export operations, including shipping, customs clearance, and documentation. Plan supply based on approved demand forecasts and adjust plans according to actual sales performance. Monitor stock levels across warehouses, maintain accurate inventory records, and conduct regular stock reconciliations. Resolve supply-related issues such as delayed shipments, incorrect quantities, damaged goods, and invoice discrepancies. Identify and implement cost reduction strategies in purchasing while maintaining product quality and service levels, in adherence to company procurement policy. Key Responsibilities: Sales Operations & Distributors Process and manage distributor orders across the GCC and North Africa, from order confirmation through to delivery. Support market launch activities with distributors as the brand expands into new countries. Maintain up-to-date order, stock, and sales data, and provide regular reports to management. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in supply chain and sales operations. Proven experience in a growing FMCG or food and beverage business. Ability to manage both strategic oversight and hands-on operational tasks. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end visa and document processing for JD International Logistics employees in Riyadh, including work visa applications, authorization documents, entry procedures, work permits, Iqama applications/renewals, information changes, cancellations, and offboarding clearance. Verify required materials based on employee nationality, application location, and visa type, and follow up on pre-processing steps such as medical examinations, degree authentication, notarization, and legalization. Coordinate with Saudi government departments, business platforms, and local service agencies using Arabic to track progress of work visas, permits, and residency documents. Assist in resolving returned materials, application anomalies, quota issues, and other local business difficulties. Establish and maintain ledgers for visas, work permits, and residency documents, tracking progress, validity, and setting expiration reminders. Understanding of material and process differences corresponding to various nationalities, application locations, and visa types. Meticulous and rigorous work style with strong sensitivity to document validity, material accuracy, and processing efficiency. Capable of multitasking, progress tracking, anomaly handling, and cross-departmental coordination. Ability to manage work pressure during peak processing periods. Understanding of basic rules regarding foreign labor employment, work permits, residency documents, and Nitaqat Saudization in Saudi Arabia. Ability to identify common business risks and escalate them for timely handling. Experience in HR SSC, shared service centers, or international assignment support is preferred. 4f6db69f6ab9f539.description: About the Role Mirnah Technology Systems is seeking a Software Presale Engineer to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial in supporting the sales team throughout the technical and solution-selling cycle. The Software Presale Engineer acts as the technical counterpart to the Sales Account Manager, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically sound, clearly scoped, and deliverable. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer business and technical requirements. Conduct discovery sessions and requirement-gathering meetings with customers. Translate customer requirements into suitable solution designs using Mirnah’s product portfolio (RoutePro, OrderPro, StockPro, AssetPro, ForecastPro, Business Analytics). Explain solution architecture, integration requirements, hosting options, and technical capabilities. Support discussions related to APIs, ERP, CRM, WMS, cloud, mobility, and enterprise integrations, including connections to SAP, Oracle Fusion, and JD Edwards. Identify technical risks, gaps, and dependencies during the sales cycle and ensure they are reflected in proposals. Prepare and deliver solution presentations, demonstrations, and proofs of concept. Prepare technical proposals, solution descriptions, scopes of work, and related documentation. Support RFP, RFI, and tender responses, including technical compliance and clarifications. Coordinate with technical, product, implementation, and delivery teams. Support the handover of awarded projects to implementation and project teams. Provide product feedback to the product team based on recurring customer requirements and competitive gaps. Required Skills and Attributes Consultative Approach: Ability to uncover real requirements before proposing solutions. Technical Credibility: Explaining architecture and integration clearly to both business and IT audiences. Clear Communication: Transforming complex solutions into clear presentations and documents in both Arabic and English. Analytical Thinking: Breaking down customer operations into processes, data, and integration points. Realism: Proposing only what can be delivered and openly addressing risks. Collaboration: Working effectively with sales, product, and delivery teams. Organization: Managing multiple opportunities, demos, and deadlines concurrently. Maintaining in-depth, hands-on knowledge of Mirnah’s products, configuration options, and integration capabilities. Keeping up to date with market trends, competitor solutions, and customer requirements. Handling customer information, requirements, and system details confidentially. Key metrics include the completeness and accuracy of discovery, the suitability and deliverability of solution designs, the effectiveness of demonstrations, timely and consistent proposal delivery, early identification of risks, contribution to sales wins, smooth project handovers, and demo readiness. Work Environment and Location This position is based in Mirnah’s offices in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role combines office work, including solution design, documentation, and demo preparation, with workshops, presentations, and demonstrations at customer premises. Travel within Saudi Arabia is required, sometimes at short notice, and may involve setting up and operating demonstration equipment such such as rugged handheld devices.

4fe09595bac41217.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المحطه للمقاولات عن مشرف موقع إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان تطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات في المواقع المختلفة، ومتابعة الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مدى التزام مواقع الإنشاءات بالقواعد واللوائح المعمول بها. الإبلاغ عن أي مخالفات يتم رصدها وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في المواقع الإنشائية لضمان الامتثال الكامل. مراجعة المخططات الأولية والخطط الخاصة بمشاريع الإنشاءات وإصدار التراخيص للمضي قدماً في الأعمال عند استيفاء الشروط. فحص الأنظمة والمعدات مثل أجهزة الرفع والنقل والممرات الجانبية المتحركة، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المطلوبة. تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جازان. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة المحطه للمقاولات، مع التركيز على الإشراف المباشر في المواقع الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4ff1c583fc707ab8.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a HSE Lead for a full-time position in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This role involves leading health, safety, and environmental (HSE) assurance for a Water Pipeline project. The HSE Lead will ensure that Contractors deliver work safely and in compliance with contractual HSE requirements, project HSE standards, and Saudi regulations. Role Overview The successful candidate will oversee Contractor HSE performance across pipeline corridors, pump stations, and associated works. This position requires driving a strong safety culture and supporting zero harm through effective risk management, assurance, incident management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Review and approve Contractor HSE deliverables, including HSE Plans, Environmental Management Plans, risk assessments, method statements, emergency response plans, and traffic management plans. Oversee control of high-risk pipeline activities such as deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe handling, confined space entry, hot work, hydrotesting, working near live utilities, and energisation. Monitor the implementation of permit-to-work systems, safe systems of work, and critical risk controls across pipeline corridors, pump stations, and reservoir sites. Plan and conduct HSE inspections, audits, and site walks, tracking findings and corrective actions through to close-out. Lead or support incident reporting and investigation, root cause analysis, and the sharing of lessons learned. Oversee road and driving safety across long linear pipeline corridors, including journey management, fatigue management, defensive driving, and logistics traffic controls. Ensure environmental controls are implemented, covering waste management, dust, noise, spill prevention, water discharge from hydrotesting, and protection of sensitive habitats. Oversee worker welfare, heat stress management, and emergency response arrangements for remote linear sites, including drills and medical evacuation. Prepare HSE performance reports and KPIs (leading and lagging), and present HSE performance and risks to project leadership. Promote a positive safety culture through leadership engagement, HSE campaigns, toolbox talks, training, and recognition. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. Demonstrated experience in leading HSE assurance for large-scale projects, preferably in pipeline or infrastructure. Knowledge of Saudi HSE regulations and international standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Tabuk, focusing on a Water Pipeline project. The role involves overseeing HSE performance across various site locations, including pipeline corridors, pump stations, and reservoir sites. Application Information Parsons Corporation values individuals who thrive in a collaborative environment and are committed to achieving their full potential. Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

This full-time role involves operating computer-controlled machinery for processing wood and other furniture materials, ensuring precise production according to technical specifications and maintaining high product quality and workplace safety. Select and execute approved CNC programs based on production requirements. Read and interpret technical drawings, dimensions, and cutting specifications. Inspect finished components to ensure accuracy and compliance with quality standards. Monitor machine performance and report technical issues or production irregularities. Replace cutting tools as needed and perform routine machine cleaning and maintenance. Minimize material waste and ensure efficient use of raw materials. Basic knowledge of CNC machine operations and wood-cutting processes. Ability to read technical drawings and understand measurements. Familiarity with machine tools, cutting equipment, and material handling. Good attention to detail and quality control. Ability to identify basic machine faults and report maintenance requirements. Commitment to workplace safety and production procedures. Technical or vocational training in CNC operation is preferred. Preferred Experience Experience operating CNC routers and panel-cutting machines in furniture factories. Knowledge of MDF, plywood, solid wood, and other furniture materials. Basic understanding of CNC programming and machine setup. Ability to work independently and meet production deadlines. 4fe66bcd8aa99609.description: About Orange Child Development Centre Orange Child Development Centre is a specialized facility in Al Khobar, Eastern region, dedicated to providing rehabilitation and early intervention services for children. Our comprehensive services include speech and language therapy, occupational therapy, behavioral therapy, special education, and psychological and developmental support. The Role of Speech and Language Therapist We are seeking a Speech and Language Therapist to join our team. This full-time role involves supporting children in developing their communication, language, and speech skills through evidence-based therapeutic approaches. The position requires 0-1 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive assessments of children's speech, language, and communication skills using appropriate tools. Identify speech, language, and communication disorders, including language delay, speech sound disorders, stuttering, and communication difficulties associated with Autism Spectrum Disorder. Prepare assessment reports and develop individualized treatment plans based on each child's needs. Provide speech, language, and communication therapy sessions, focusing on receptive and expressive language skills, speech, and social communication. Monitor children's progress, adjust treatment plans, and document all therapy sessions and clinical observations accurately. Prepare periodic reports to measure progress and ensure therapeutic goals are met. Collaborate with occupational therapists, behavioral therapists, psychologists, and special education specialists within a multidisciplinary team. Strong knowledge of HVAC controls, BMS architecture, and field instrumentation. 4f055b11234fa5f1.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطط العلاج، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تركيبات الأسنان ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية المطلوبة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع خطة علاجية متكاملة مع برنامجها الزمني. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير العمل والتوثيق المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء أداء جميع مهام طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية الصحية اللازمة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان بمدينة تبوك. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة.

4f1ba6db7ac06891.description: About the Role The Public Investment Fund (PIF) is seeking a Portfolio Strategy and Asset Allocation Professional to join its International Investments team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing to the development, implementation, and ongoing oversight of strategic asset allocation frameworks and diversified multi-asset portfolios. The professional will support long-term portfolio construction aligned with investment objectives and policy statements. Key Responsibilities Support the development, review, and implementation of Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) frameworks in alignment with long-term objectives, risk tolerance, and Investment Policy Statement (IPS) constraints. Contribute to the development and periodic review of capital market assumptions, including expected returns, volatility, and correlations across various asset classes. Support the development and review of investment policy statements, policy benchmarks, allocation ranges, and rebalancing frameworks. Collaborate with the Portfolio Performance and Analytics team to monitor portfolio performance, attribution, and risk exposures against approved benchmarks and investment policy requirements. Assess portfolio exposure across asset classes, geographies, sectors, currencies, and other investment factors, including concentration and liquidity risks. Evaluate specialized investment strategies and implementation approaches for their contribution to portfolio objectives, diversification, and risk-adjusted outcomes. Support approved allocation changes and portfolio rebalancing by coordinating with external manager selection teams and other relevant PIF departments. Prepare investment proposals, recommendations, and memos. Contribute to representing PIF International Investments at conferences and industry events related to international public markets. Prepare presentations and updates pertaining to International Public Investments proposals and performance for PIF Committees and Executive Management. Contribute to the preparation of internal update reports and required updates for the PIF Board and related committees and/or other entities. Operational Accountabilities Implement operational excellence improvement initiatives and propose enhancements to systems, processes, and practices, considering international leading practices to continuously improve organizational effectiveness and business performance. Support the development of policies, systems, processes, procedures, and controls as requested, or propose relevant enhancements as needed, ensuring alignment and adherence to compliance, risk, audit, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. 4f304fe0db5ebddc.description: About the Role Panda Retail Company – Savola Group is seeking a Customer Helpdesk ******* - Business Performance Improvement 2 to join their team in Jeddah. This role is a full-time employee position and requires 1-3 years of related business experience. The Customer Helpdesk Officer will be responsible for managing and validating various operational requests related to supply chain and store operations. Key Responsibilities Manage the standardization and transformation of Operations team requests into the Panda ticketing system, including pre-issues, emergency orders, cross-dock replacement POs, replenishment holds, store closures, incident reporting, and overstock/damaged/expiry returns. Validate additional pre-issue and emergency DSD orders from Operations and SC Planning teams against agreed criteria before communicating with the Order Management team for manual order execution. Validate Operations requests for NTI items in alignment with the SC Planning team to ensure timely availability at stores. Analyze Operations requests for cross-dock replacement POs and other financially problematic replacement POs, taking appropriate action before communicating with Order Management for execution. Ensure overstock analysis criteria are current and include new criteria to improve stock position evaluation efficiency in Relex & Power BI overstock reporting tools, in alignment with cross-functional stakeholders. Validate biweekly overstock evaluation analysis across all stores for all business units, including promo and regular leftover quantities. Validate overstock return requests from stores against agreed criteria, including promo repetition, days of cover, mode of delivery, minimum display quantities, contractual obligations with suppliers, agreed schedules, and DC capacity. Follow up with Distribution Centers (DCs) to ensure timely issuance of return authorization documents for all stores. Monitor actual store returns and their compliance with authorized items/quantities, sharing periodical overstock progress reports with cross-functional stakeholders. Validate damaged and expiry return requests from the operations team against agreed criteria, and follow up with DCs to issue return authorization documents on time for all stores. Verify commercial team requests for Return to Vendor (RTV) against agreed criteria and timelines, initiating corresponding actions with Operations and DC teams. Manage operations requests related to store closures, store re-openings, temporary replenishment holds, resuming replenishment, and incident & event reporting to ensure proper reflection on RELEX, RMFCS, and manual replenishment tools. Develop SC surveys for all services offered by supply chain functions, in alignment with the Operations team, ensuring compatibility of survey elements with the platform used. Analyze quarterly SC Survey feedback, comparing it with previous results, and share outcomes with respective supply chain functions for corrective actions when needed. Design and create agreed DC tickets under the SC Helpdesk area, monitoring them for successful closure and following up with related stakeholders upon delay (*, Low Shelf Life Receiving & DC Stock Adjustment). Take initiative in analyzing problematic areas related to SC Helpdesk by identifying various levels, down to SKU/Store/Date level. Qualifications and Experience 1-3 years of related business experience. Location This position is based in Jeddah. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role.

4f43bb93675ec8a7.description: نبحث عن مهندس ميكانيكا وكهرباء وسباكة ذي خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز والمساهمة في تنفيذ مشاريعنا الهندسية بكفاءة. ستشمل مسؤولياتك الإشراف على تصميم وتركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الميكانيكية والكهربائية وأنظمة السباكة، مع ضمان الالتزام بأعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة. نتطلع إلى مرشح مبدع وقادر على حل المشكلات ولديه شغف بالتفوق في مجال الهندسة.

4f4edea10fa62986.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صالح حسين سالم ال سلامه وشريكه عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الأنشطة الهندسية الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك البحث والتصميم والإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الهندسة الميكانيكية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تساهم في سير العمليات الهندسية بسلاسة وفعالية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: المساعدة في أبحاث الهندسة الميكانيكية وتصميم المعدات والنظم. دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة للمعدات والنظم. المساهمة في تطوير نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. تقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة ضمن عملية التصميم الكلية. الإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع الهندسية. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها لضمان استمرارية التشغيل. متطلبات السلامة والبيئة يجب على شاغل الوظيفة الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. هذا يضمن بيئة عمل آمنة ومستدامة لجميع الأفراد والمشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على المساعدة في الأبحاث والتصميم الهندسي. فهم جيد لعمليات الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في أبها، عسير، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم لهذه الفرصة المهنية في شركة صالح حسين سالم ال سلامه وشريكه.

With over 45 years of experience, Algihaz Contracting has consistently delivered excellence in engineering design and construction across infrastructure and essential services.
